name: Historification
author: thalesjacobi

sections.description:
Every business has a history worth telling. Historification turns it into the short videos your customers actually watch.

Give it one topic from the story of your company, your industry or your region. Historification writes the article, creates a 10-image carousel and produces a narrated vertical video in your brand’s style. It then publishes them to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook on your schedule.

It is built for business owners and marketing teams who want consistent, distinctive content without filming, editing or a production team. Real stories give your brand something to say beyond the next offer, and they give people a reason to watch to the end.

What you get from each topic

  • A full article on your own website, written in your brand’s voice, with optional references
  • A 10-image carousel in one consistent visual style that you choose
  • A narrated vertical video with voiceover and captions, ready for reels and shorts
  • Publishing to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook, with captions written for you
  • Performance insights, showing views and engagement for each article

How it works

  1. Tell it about your business. Setup reads your website, or a short description, and drafts your profile, voice and audience for you to edit.
  2. Choose your look. Compare three image styles and fine-tune your favourite, then pick a narrator.
  3. Preview your style. See real images made for your business before you choose a plan.
  4. Create and publish. Generate a batch of ideas, turn them into articles, carousels and videos, and set how often they go out.

You stay in control

  • Nothing is published during setup.
  • Every article, image and caption can be reviewed and edited before it goes out.
  • You set your own ground rules, such as topics to avoid or spelling to use.
  • Your articles and media live in your own WordPress site, so your content stays yours.

Plans

  • Free: up to 5 articles a month. No card needed.
  • Starter (£29/month): one fully produced article a day.
  • Pro (£79/month): two fully produced articles a day, with the highest limits.

What you need to know

Historification relies on a hosted service, so a Historification account is required. Setup creates a free one for you. Your site details and the content you choose to process are sent to that service, which uses AI to generate your content; see “External services” below for exactly what is sent and when.

External services

Historification is a client for a hosted backend and relies on the third-party services below. Data is sent only when you take the matching action (generate content, register, subscribe, connect an account, publish). By using the plugin you consent to these data flows; full details are in the Historification Privacy Policy (https://historification.net/privacy) and Terms (https://historification.net/terms).

  1. Historification backend API (required) — https://api.historification.net
    What it is: the hosted service that does the AI generation, media assembly, billing and publishing.
    Data sent, and when:

* When you generate content: the article title and body you choose to process, plus your topic profile (niche, voice, brand, audience) and your site domain.
* When you register or subscribe: your name, email address, business name, country and IP address.
* When you connect a social account: the OAuth authorization completes on the backend and the resulting access tokens are stored there — never in WordPress.
* Ongoing: article/publish counts, used to enforce your plan limits.
Terms: https://historification.net/terms — Privacy: https://historification.net/privacy

  1. Stripe (payments) — https://stripe.com
    What it is: our payment processor. Paid plans are billed through Stripe.
    Data sent, and when: when you upgrade to a paid plan or open “Manage billing”, the plugin redirects your browser to Stripe’s secure hosted checkout / billing portal to enter and manage your card. Card details are handled entirely by Stripe and never pass through the plugin or the Historification backend.
    Terms: https://stripe.com/legal/ssa — Privacy: https://stripe.com/privacy

  2. AI, media hosting and social publishing (used by the backend on your behalf)
    To produce and deliver your content, the backend in turn uses OpenAI (text, image and voice generation), Google Cloud Storage (hosting generated images and video), and the social networks you connect (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook) when you publish to them. The complete list of sub-processors and what each stores is in the Privacy Policy: https://historification.net/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Historification”, then install and activate it.
  2. Open Historification in the admin menu and follow the setup, which takes a few minutes and creates your free account.
  3. Preview your image style, then choose a plan. The Free plan needs no card.
  4. Connect YouTube, Instagram and Facebook under Historification > Settings > Networks.
  5. Go to Historification > Articles, generate your first ideas and create your content.
sections.faq:
My business isn’t about history. Is this for me?

Yes, if your business has a story to tell. Every company, trade and region has a past: how your industry began, the people who shaped it, or how your town grew up around it. Those stories are the raw material, and setup helps you find your angle.

Do I need an account?

Yes. Setup creates a free Historification account for your site, with no card needed. If this site already has an account, you can reconnect it with your API key.

Will it publish anything without my approval?

Nothing is published during setup. Once you connect your networks, finished articles go out on your publishing schedule, so review them while they are drafts. You can turn off automatic social publishing under Settings > Features.

Is the AI-written content accurate?

AI can make mistakes, especially with dates, names and historical detail. Please review content before it goes out. You can ask for references in articles, and set ground rules for what to always avoid or include.

Where is my content stored?

In your own WordPress site. Articles are saved as WordPress content, and generated images and videos are copied into your Media Library folder. The Historification service only keeps generated files temporarily.

How much does Historification cost?

There is a Free tier. Paid plans are Starter (£29/month) and Pro (£79/month), billed monthly. The Free plan includes up to 5 articles a month; Starter gives one fully produced article a day and Pro gives two. See https://historification.net for current plans and limits.

How are payments handled?

Securely by Stripe. When you subscribe you are taken to Stripe’s hosted checkout to enter your card — card details never touch your WordPress site or the Historification backend. You can update your card or cancel at any time from the in-plugin “Manage billing” button, which opens your Stripe billing portal.

When am I charged, and when does a plan change take effect?

Upgrading from Free starts your subscription immediately: you pay a prorated part-month amount for the rest of the current month, then the full monthly price on the 1st of each month after. Switching between paid plans, or downgrading, takes effect on the 1st of the following month.

How do I cancel, and do you offer refunds?

Cancel any time (Settings → Change plan → Free, or via the Stripe billing portal). Your paid plan stays active until the end of the period you have already paid for, then drops to Free. Payments are non-refundable — there are no refunds for partial months, unused allowances or downgrades. See https://historification.net/terms.

What data does the plugin send, and where?

See the “External services” section above. In short: your content and account details go to the Historification service; payment details go to Stripe; your articles themselves stay in WordPress.
sections.changelog:
2.4.50

  • New: every Historification screen now has an entry in WordPress’s own Help tab (top right), listing the few guide articles that answer what is on that screen, plus a link to the assistant.
  • The user guide can now be linked to article by article, so help links open the right answer instead of the top of the page.

2.4.49

  • Fixed: an article could be marked as failed and stay that way even after the work finished — a finished, published article showing a red failure for ever. A problem is now judged from what the article is actually missing, so stale failures clear themselves.
  • New: an article that fails now says so. A red warning and the reason appear on its row in the Articles list, with a “Try again” button; a notice appears across the plugin; and you get an email (at most one a day, switch it off in Settings).
  • Fixed: a content build that stopped part-way (a server timeout while making a video) could stay stuck for good. It now restarts itself, and the next step is booked before the work starts so a crash can no longer break the chain.
  • New: the Articles page always shows the build queue — how many articles are waiting, and a warning with a Resume button if it has stopped making progress.
  • New: your social analytics now refresh automatically once a day, so Social Insights stays up to date without pressing “Sync now”. Turn it off under Settings > Features.
  • Article ideas are no longer steered towards postage stamps, whatever your site is about.
  • Removed a stray mention of another website from the slideshow help text.

2.4.48

  • Fixed: “Generate everything” could write the same article more than once, using up extra articles from your monthly plan.

2.4.47

  • Setup and plan descriptions now say exactly what you see during setup.

2.4.46

  • Clearer wording throughout the plugin and setup, written for businesses.
  • New logo, menu icon and a consistent look across the setup screens.
  • Dashboard totals now count only content made with Historification, matching the Articles page.
  • Messages before setup is finished now point to Setup.
  • More helpful messages when content generation is temporarily unavailable.
  • Fixed a PHP warning on the Settings page before an account is connected.

2.4.45

  • Unique prefixes throughout: the wizard and slideshow JavaScript objects, the insights transient, and the insights database table now all use the full historification prefix instead of the short hsf one.
  • Existing insights data is migrated automatically on upgrade — no data is lost.

2.4.44

  • Publishing schedule is now fully user-configurable (cadence + times), no longer tied to the plan.
  • All admin JavaScript is enqueued via wp_add_inline_script instead of inline tags.
  • Prefixed global helper functions; removed the public reconnect-challenge REST route (reconnect now uses your API key); dropped bundled translations (handled via translate.wordpress.org).

2.4.43

  • Onboarding wizard: keyless start, three-style picker, registration at the end with Terms & Privacy acceptance.
  • Stripe billing: in-plugin plan changes open Stripe Checkout directly; subscriptions align to the calendar month with a prorated first charge; manage/cancel via the Stripe billing portal.
  • Support assistant, in-plugin help guide, and clearer plan/billing copy.
  • readme: full external-services disclosure (Historification backend, Stripe, and sub-processors) and expanded billing FAQ.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: article, carousel, narrated video, publishing to YouTube/Instagram/Facebook, scheduling, dashboard.
